crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, and work on your highest priority task.

crons.name: usage-monitor
crons.prompt: Run the usage monitor — lightweight: just run the script and exit; do NOT parse its output or analyze. Command: bash "$CTX_FRAMEWORK_ROOT/bus/check-usage-api.sh" --warn-7day 80 --warn-5h 90 . The script AUTO-SENDS its own Telegram threshold alerts (Claude Max 7-day CODE RED at >=80%, 5-hour warning at >=90%, plus the Codex equivalents) and owns ALL alerting — do NOT send any alerts yourself (that double-alerts and wastes a cycle). ONLY if the command exits non-zero, send the-orchestrator a brief message with the error. Otherwise exit quietly.

crons.name: nightly-metrics
crons.prompt: Run nightly metrics collection: cortextos bus collect-metrics. Review the output and report any anomalies via Telegram to the orchestrator.

crons.name: auto-commit
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/local-version-control/SKILL.md and execute the daily version control workflow: preview with `cortextos bus auto-commit --dry-run`, review the files for PII/secrets, then commit the snapshot to the ISOLATED branch via `cortextos bus auto-commit --branch "analyst-snapshots/$(date -u +%F)" -m "daily: <summary>"`. This commits to an isolated ref without touching main/HEAD/working tree. Never commit to mainline; never push.

crons.name: check-upstream
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/upstream-sync/SKILL.md and execute the upstream sync workflow. Check for framework updates and report to the orchestrator.

crons.name: catalog-browse
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/catalog-browse/SKILL.md and execute the catalog browse workflow. Check for new community skills and recommend useful ones.
